messages.content: Tell me about the CareerTalkLab project.
CareerTalkLab is John Serra’s language-learning platform project. See [CareerTalkLab](https://johnserra.com/projects/careertalklab).
What technologies does it use? Cite the project source.

requests.answer:
CareerTalkLab utilizes a range of technologies across its different components. The frontend is built with Next.js 16.1 (App Router), React 19, and TypeScript, with styling provided by Tailwind CSS 4 and shadcn/ui. For the backend and authentication, it uses Supabase, which includes PostgreSQL, Auth, RLS, and Edge Functions.

The content is managed by a JSON-native Lesson Engine that supports over 8 interactive block types. AI feedback is powered by the Anthropic Claude API, which drafts corrections for student writing. A Python-based pipeline handles news ingestion, using RSS feeds and Gemini 2.0 Flash. The project also features a 4-tier automated evaluation suite for testing.

For more details, you can refer to the [CareerTalkLab](https://johnserra.com/projects/careertalklab) project page.
